title: Team split body
description: A team on one contract (register row JO6; spec-delta S1702): the lead (the contract's performer) states each member's part and its share of the price in permille, and every other member cosigns, so no one is given a share it did not accept (team_split_not_the_lead, team_split_needs_member_consent). The shares add up to 1000 (team_split_shares), the lead is a member (team_split_lead_missing), members are different agents with passports and none is the principal (team_split_duplicate_member, team_member_unknown, team_split_principal_member). It is made before delivery (team_split_too_late) and once (team_split_known). When the contract is paid, the log pays each member its share of what is released, the lead keeping the rest; the fault of a ruling stays the lead's alone, because the Bond is the lead's. Subject: the contract. Chain: none (prev is null).
